title: Hoodlum Soldier Ep 15: Reunion

scenes.say: The unit gets together ten years later. Barbecue. Bad jokes. Old wounds.
scenes.visual: a backyard barbecue with smoke rising and veterans laughing, faces turned away, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Some came home whole. Some didn't come home at all.
scenes.visual: a folding chair left empty with a cap resting on it, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: They set a plate for Roddy. Nobody says anything about it.
scenes.visual: an empty plate at a picnic table beside a small flag, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: The private from the outpost brings his kids to meet Sarge.
scenes.visual: a veteran crouching to greet two small children, seen from behind, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: You kept us alive on that hill, he tells Ali.
scenes.visual: two men embracing in a backyard at sunset, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Ali shakes his head. We kept each other alive.
scenes.visual: a circle of hands stacked together, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: They tell Roddy stories until it hurts to laugh.
scenes.visual: men laughing around a fire pit at night, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Grief and joy sit at the same table.
scenes.visual: a table with drinks, photos and a folded flag under string lights, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Brotherhood doesn't end when the tour does.
scenes.visual: silhouettes of veterans standing together against a sunset, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: He leaves with more family than he came with.
scenes.visual: a car driving away down a suburban road at dusk, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Follow for Episode Sixteen. Turn negative into positive.
scenes.visual: a group photo pinned to a fridge, warm light, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

caption: HOODLUM SOLDIER, Episode 15 of 25: Reunion. The true-story series from the book by Elvin Torres Sr. New episode every 48 hours.
